An element is damaged and needs replacing
The boiler's thermal fuse is starting to fail

q: Stock integration: you notice a buzz and a burning smell near the switches. What do you do?
a: Switch off and unplug: a live parked connector may touch metal
Keep brewing: new spades buzz until they bed in
Switch off at the power switch, but leave it plugged in
Tape over the switch backs while it runs
why: Parked connectors stay live in stock integration. Unplug, check every one is insulated and tied down, and rerun f8 and f9 for a low-voltage wire on a mains spade.

q: An over-the-air update is running. What's the rule?
a: Don't power down: a failed one reverts by itself
Power-cycle it if the progress stalls for a minute
Flash the screen first, then the core
Unplug the screen cable so the core flashes faster
why: Powering down mid-update is the thing to avoid. If one fails, connect straight to the Gaggiuino access point and retry, core first, then the screen.

q: The hardware scales stay at 0. What do you check first?
a: That hardware scales are turned on in the settings
That the magnets sit flush with the surface
That the ToF sensor is centered over the water
That the HX711 board has an E- to GND jumper
why: It's the first cause on the list. Then measure 5 V at the HX711 board and check the cable pin by pin against J8 before calibrating.
